test_Transformer_layer_norm: test the Transformer class with layer_norm enabled and disabled to verify zero output for uniform inputs
test_Transformer_causal_attention: test the Transformer class with causal and non-causal attention to verify masked token behavior
test_Transformer_activation_function: test the Transformer class with a zero activation function to verify equivalence to zeroed MLP weights
test_CompiledTransformerModel_embedding: test the CompiledTransformerModel embed method to verify one-hot token and position embeddings produce expected results
test_CompiledTransformerModel_embed_unem: test the CompiledTransformerModel embed and unembed pipeline to verify round-trip token reconstruction
